summary.prose: Eight small tasks. A baseline is recorded first, then five independent production edits land in dependency order: the shared implied-story rule, the sized-route anchor, the define-missing message, the chain report (head reader and paths, then next actions) and the JetBrains Workflows reader. A new integration test file proves the LLD, review, anchor and chain behaviour against a seeded ISSUE-only repo, and a final task compares the workflow, MCP and JetBrains test results with the recorded baseline.

tasks.title: Record the baseline, add the shared implied-story rule and point the tracker resolver at it
tasks.summary: Before any edit, run the workflow and MCP test subsets and the type check and record the result as the baseline for this Story. Then in src/workflow/storage.ts, next to readEpicDefinitionCore, add the exported constant IMPLIED_ISSUE_STORY_ID ('s1') and impliedIssueStories(issue) returning the single { id, title } entry. Change src/workflow/tracker/resolve.ts storyEvidence (the 'implied' branch) to compare against the constant instead of the literal. Behaviour is unchanged.

tasks.title: Make the chain report read an ISSUE-anchored definition, its story, its path and its label
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/chain.ts read the definition head as a discriminated DEF-or-ISSUE value (the DEF wins when both exist). For an ISSUE head: stories holds the implied s1 from impliedIssueStories; each story path is built from the LLD's own meta (workItemAnchorCreatedAt, workItemKindOf, meta.epicSlug) so it points under docs/standalone; define reflects the ISSUE's existence, approval and rejection with its path the ISSUE document; hld is absent. ChainReport gains one optional field, definitionKind, and formatChainReport labels the definition as an ISSUE for an ISSUE head and leaves DEF output byte-identical. The existing DEF-anchored chain tests run first and must stay green. Next-action ordering is t5.

An ISSUE head never yields run-hld, approve-hld, review-amendment, refresh-stale, push-tracker or sync-tracker. DEF-anchored ordering is untouched.

tasks.title: Add the identity-regression integration tests for an ISSUE-anchored LLD
tasks.summary: Create src/workflow/__tests__/issue-anchored-route.test.ts, modelled on seedIssueRepo in folder-identity-finalize.test.ts. Against a seeded ISSUE-only repo it proves that a standalone LLD started with the issue hash and s1 is written as LLD-<issueHash>-s1 with the ISSUE's label, epicCreatedAt and folder and no second root; that design review classifies it as kind issue with the ISSUE as originating_issue; that a second start revises the same LLD; that a genuine standalone feature still mints its own root, an Epic story still requires its DEF and HLD, requireApprovedEpic still refuses an ISSUE, and a bugfix LLD with no ISSUE provenance is still rejected; and that the chain report returns the implied s1 and chain-complete once s1's LLD is approved. PLAN and BUILD identity is scoped to the helpers they use (requireEpicAnchor, inheritedStoryStandalone, inheritedEpicSlug) on the same seeded repo, plus the PLAN finalizer through an existing plan test fixture where one exists; a full BUILD record is not produced. No production code changes.

tasks.title: Make the JetBrains Workflows reader list an ISSUE-anchored work item
tasks.summary: In jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/workflow/WorkflowChainReader.kt, readDir also enumerates ISSUE-<hash>.json for hashes that have no DEF-<hash>.json and projects each as a chain entry: define mark from the ISSUE's meta.approvedAt and meta.rejectedAt, hld absent, one implied story s1 titled with the ISSUE body title with hasLld and approved read from LLD-<hash>-s1.json and never stale, zero amendments, and a plain hint (Approve issue, Re-run issue, Design story s1, Approve LLD for s1, Chain complete) that never names an HLD, amendment or stale step. WorkflowChainDto gains a defaulted definitionKind field so existing callers compile unchanged. A hash with both a DEF and an ISSUE is listed once, as the DEF; a malformed ISSUE contributes nothing. Read-only, no socket, never throws. DEF entries and their hints are unchanged. Add the tests to WorkflowChainReaderTest.kt.
